entries.title: 1. The Cinematic Product Reveal
entries.base_prompt: [Subject: Detailed description of product] + [Environment: Contextual setting] + [Lighting: Golden hour/cinematic/studio] + [Camera: Lens type, angle, depth of field] + [Mood: Specific emotional anchor] --ar 16:9 --v 6.0

metadata.use_case: Hero images for website landing pages or high-end social media ads.

entries.title: 2. The Lifestyle Narrative
entries.base_prompt: [Persona: Character description] + [Action: Natural, unposed interaction with product] + [Setting: Relatable yet aspirational environment] + [Lighting: Soft natural light/dappled sunlight] + [Camera: Handheld feel, slight motion blur, shallow DOF] --ar 4:5

metadata.use_case: Creating authentic-feeling user-generated content (UGC) that feels "expensive."

entries.title: 3. The Abstract Texture Study
entries.base_prompt: [Macro Subject: Close-up of material/product detail] + [Lighting: Harsh side-lighting to emphasize texture] + [Color Palette: Brand colors applied] + [Atmosphere: Minimalist, clean, high-contrast] --ar 1:1

metadata.use_case: Backgrounds, social media textures, or macro-detail shots for luxury branding.
